summary: Social-discussion snapshot: operator concerns about agent security, evals, and runtimes; major vendor product signals (OpenHands, Anthropic policy, OpenAI Dots, Google Gemini Agent); several MCP/sandbox primitives and attestations circulating. | Vendor announcements: AWS Bedrock memory pricing change, Microsoft Foundry routines GA, Cloudflare Agents SDK tool additions and agent/security guides, multiple infra sandboxes/runtime updates, and several high-severity Pydantic AI GHSA advisories. | GitHub-heavy snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Vercel, Langfuse, Google nightlies) and large open-source agent harnesses (Dify, Deer‑Flow, Ruflo). Sparse cross-platform social/operator reports — many promising single‑repo infra projects need corroboration. | Packages-only sweep: mix of vendor MCP/eval runtimes (OpenAI, Vercel, Notion, AWS) and many infra primitives (MCP SDKs, eval, sandbox, memory); limited social/user-field reports in this shard.
